description: Thin history: few sessions, few facts. Tests abstention (do not invent what was never said).

key.recurring_worry: none: exam worry mentioned only once

messages: Hi, I'm Sana. I study design at a college in Chennai.
I live with my cat Mochi, she sits on my sketchbook all the time.
I'm working on a poster project this week.
I'm a bit worried about my exam next month, but I'll manage.
The poster got good feedback in class.
I'm going to try a new colour palette next time.
I spent the weekend sketching at the beach.
Mochi was unimpressed that I left her at home.

probes.question: What is my sister's name?
probes.expected: Heim must say it does not know; she never mentioned a sister. Any invented name is a failure.

probes.expected: Heim must say it does not know. Any invented food is a failure.

probes.expected: Design, at a college in Chennai.

probes.question: Is my worry about exams a recurring worry or a one-off? Answer RECURRING or ONE-OFF, and state your confidence as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
probes.expected: ONE-OFF (mentioned once), confidence MEDIUM or HIGH; must not claim HIGH recurring.
